def simulate_repaired_v14(case, pool_ids, allocation, tolerance, paid_policy='unresolved'):
    arrays = case_arrays_v14[case['key']]
    cl = arrays['close']
    mark = arrays['mark']
    cashdiv = arrays['cashdiv']
    bad = arrays['bad']
    r = arrays['returns']
    vo = arrays['volume']
    days = arrays['dates']
    start = case['start_index']
    shares = np.zeros(len(all_external_ids_v13), np.int64)
    cash = INITIAL
    receivable = 0.0
    values = [INITIAL]
    fees = 0.0
    turnover_sum = 0.0
    reasons = set()
    violations = 0
    cap_age = np.zeros(len(shares), int)
    minheld = 999
    maxheld = 0
    caps = np.array([0.25 if sid == '2330' else 0.1 for sid in all_external_ids_v13])
    traces = []
    poolmask = np.array([sid in pool_ids for sid in all_external_ids_v13])
    assumption_events = []
    for offset, t in enumerate(range(start, start + 24)):
        before = shares.copy()
        if paid_policy == 'waive':
            assumption_events.extend({'sid': all_external_ids_v13[j], 'date': str(days[t]), 'assumption': 'waive_paid_subscription_no_rights_asset_no_free_shares'} for j in np.flatnonzero(arrays['paid_known'][t] & bad[t] & (before > 0)))
        if np.any(bad[t] & (before > 0) & (~arrays['paid_known'][t] if paid_policy == 'waive' else True)):
            reasons.add('unmodeled_or_ambiguous_company_action_while_held')
        receivable += float(np.dot(before, cashdiv[t]))
        prior_nav = cash + np.dot(shares, np.nan_to_num(mark[t - 1]))
        if offset % 5 == 0:
            rr = r[t - 60:t]
            eligible = poolmask & np.all(np.isfinite(rr) & (rr > -1), axis=0) & np.all(np.isfinite(vo[t - 20:t]) & (vo[t - 20:t] > 0), axis=0) & ~np.any(bad[t - 60:t], axis=0) & np.isfinite(cl[t - 1]) & (cl[t - 1] > 0)
            if eligible.sum() < 25:
                reasons.add('fewer_than25_past_data_eligible_stocks')
                break
            score = 0.5 * percentile(np.prod(1 + rr[-20:], axis=0) - 1, eligible) + 0.5 * percentile(np.prod(1 + rr, axis=0) - 1, eligible)
            ordered = np.flatnonzero(eligible)
            selected = ordered[np.argsort(-score[ordered], kind='stable')[:25]]
            weights = np.full(25, 0.9 / 25) if allocation == 'equal' else 0.9 * np.linspace(1.25, 0.75, 25) / 25
            target = np.zeros_like(shares)
            target[selected] = (np.floor(weights * prior_nav / cl[t - 1, selected] / 1000) * 1000).astype(np.int64)
            if offset > 0 and tolerance:
                keep = (shares > 0) & (target > 0) & (np.abs(target - shares) * np.nan_to_num(mark[t - 1]) <= tolerance * prior_nav)
                target[keep] = shares[keep]
            cash, shares, traded, cost, missing = settle(cash, shares, target, arrays['execution'][t], arrays['available'][t])
            fees += cost
            turnover_sum += traded
            if missing:
                reasons.add('invalid_execution_price')
            traces.append({'date': str(days[t]), 'selected': [all_external_ids_v13[j] for j in selected]})
        if np.any((shares > 0) & ~np.isfinite(mark[t])):
            reasons.add('missing_held_close')
        nav = cash + np.dot(shares, np.nan_to_num(mark[t]))
        aum = nav + receivable
        values.append(aum)
        if nav <= 0:
            reasons.add('nonpositive_tradable_nav')
            break
        weights = shares * np.nan_to_num(mark[t]) / nav
        cap_age = np.where(weights > caps + 1e-12, cap_age + 1, 0)
        held = int(np.count_nonzero(shares))
        minheld = min(minheld, held)
        maxheld = max(maxheld, held)
        violations += int(cash < 0 or cash / nav >= 0.25 or (not 20 <= held <= 30) or np.any(cap_age > 5))
    invalid = bool(reasons or violations)
    vals = np.array(values)
    net = float(vals[-1] / INITIAL - 1)
    return {'paid_policy':paid_policy, 'assumption_events':assumption_events, 'case': case['key'], 'year': case['year'], 'start': str(days[start]), 'end': str(days[start + 23]), 'return': None if invalid else net, 'mdd': None if invalid else float(np.min(vals / np.maximum.accumulate(vals) - 1)), 'cost': fees / INITIAL, 'turnover': turnover_sum / INITIAL, 'invalid': bool(reasons), 'violations': violations, 'reasons': sorted(reasons), 'min_held': minheld, 'max_held': maxheld, 'trace': traces, 'path': vals.tolist() if not invalid else None}
